title: ui has no command that moves its @codesweep-ai pins
foundBy: user report (host): "is there a repinning mechanism, like maybe an npm run repin in the ui project?"
details: `package.json` pins `@codesweep-ai/ledger`, `@codesweep-ai/lint` and `@codesweep-ai/npmrevs` at exact versions. Only oss-repin moves them, and it needs every sibling checked out beside ui. The Go repositories have `make repin`, which moves their pins to the last commit each project's CI built. This repository has nothing like it, so a clone of ui alone has no way to take those builds. The ledger pin also has to move with a fresh render of `ledger/ledger.html`.
